originals.ko: 그리고 입구 안쪽에 있는 창문을 닫다
originals.why: The Welsh has no 'o ffenest' (out of the window). Its 'o' belongs to 'o fewn', and 'ffenest' is the window being closed, so it does not use this LEGO in the sense taught here.

originals.ko: 그는 혼자 창문을 열고 닫고 싶어해
originals.why: There is no 'o ffenest' in this Welsh. It only uses 'ffenest' as the object of agor/cau, so it is the wrong sense for this LEGO.
